news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: West Ham 5-3 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：西汉姆联5-3切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s suffered our first defeat in almost two months as, despite goals from Heze Grimwade, Ibrahim Rabbaj and Riley Ebho, the Blues were beaten by West Ham United. We started superbly, asking plenty of questions of the hosts' backline, and broke the deadlock in the 26th minute through yet another Grimwade set piece. Rabbaj claimed our second with a placed finish into the left corner just after the half-hour mark, but the score was 2-1 at the break as Tyrone Omotoye pulled a goal back for the hosts. In the second period, we re-established our two-goal lead thanks to Ebho. Unfortunately, West Ham scored three goals in six minutes to make it 4-3 and, while we tried to equalise, the Hammers had the final say as they netted their fifth of the afternoon. The Blues came racing out the blocks, piling pressure on West Ham’s backline. Within seven minutes, we had earned three corners, and our pressure midway through the half was after Rabbaj received the ball on the right flank and made a darting run towards the penalty area. His quick feet and pace were too much for the West Ham defence, who were forced to foul the Moroccan in a dangerous area. Grimwade stepped up and continued to prove himself as a free-kick specialist, firing the ball into the far corner. Rabbaj extended our lead five minutes later, netting his first goal of the season. Jayden Malundama came close to marking his return to the starting eleven with a goal but was thwarted by Felix Lewis-Ayesta. The loose ball fell to the edge of the box and Rabbaj picked his spot perfectly. He almost had a brace before the interval when he spotted the Hammers keeper off his line at the start of another attack. Rabbaj went for the spectacular from the halfway line and wasn’t far away, his effort whistled just wide of the right post. However, in the final action of the half, West Ham made it 2-1 through Omotoye. Hungry for more in the second period, Rabbaj kept testing Lewis-Ayesta and troubling the opposition. We had an array of chances, with Andrew Pennie unlucky not to turn his header toward goal and Jashayde Greenwood a whisker away from close range. It was Ebho who got our third, though, as he collected the ball off Grimwade and let fly from distance. His effort took a deflection and beat Lewis-Ayesta to reinstate our two-goal advantage. It wasn't one we were able to keep, though. With 20 minutes remaining, we were caught in possession and Jude Longman halved the deficit once more. The Blues responded well initially, as Greenwood's thumping strike was tipped onto the crossbar by Lewis-Ayesta, earning us a corner. Unfortunately, we were caught on the counter and punished as Omotoye got his second of the afternoon and equalise for the Hammers. Moments after the leveller, we conceded a penalty which Longman converted to put us behind for the first time in the contest. We pushed for an equaliser but West Ham managed a fifth before the final whistle to inflict our first defeat since the start of September. This defeat sees us drop to 2nd position and remain on 21 points. We now trail the league leaders by two points. Chelsea Under-18s host Charlton Athletic in the Premier League Cup on Saturday 7 November at Cobham Training Ground. The game gets underway at 11am GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下青年队遭遇近两个月来的首场失利，尽管赫泽·格里姆韦德、易卜拉欣·拉巴伊和莱利·埃博进球，但蓝军还是被西汉姆联队击败。我们开局非常出色，对主队的后防线提出了很多问题，并在第 26 分钟通过格里姆韦德的另一个定位球打破了僵局。半小时后，拉巴伊在左侧角球中射门，取得了我们的第二个进球，但中场休息时，蒂龙·奥莫托耶为主队扳回一球，比分变为 2-1。在第二节，我们凭借埃博重新确立了两球领先优势。不幸的是，西汉姆联队在六分钟内连进三球，将比分改写为4-3，当我们试图扳平比分时，铁锤帮拥有最终决定权，他们打进了下午的第五粒进球。蓝军冲出禁区，给西汉姆联的后防线施加压力。七分钟之内，我们就获得了三个角球，半场中段我们的压力来自于拉巴伊在右翼接球后冲向禁区。他的快速脚步和速度让西汉姆联的防守难以承受，西汉姆联被迫在危险区域对摩洛哥人犯规。格里姆韦德挺身而出，继续证明自己是任意球专家，将球射入远角。五分钟后，拉巴伊扩大了我们的领先优势，打进了他本赛季的第一个进球。杰登·马伦达马 (Jayden Malundama) 差点凭借一粒进球重返首发十一人名单，但被菲利克斯·刘易斯·阿耶斯塔 (Felix Lewis-Ayesta) 挡出。球落到了禁区边缘，拉巴伊完美地选准了自己的位置。中场休息前，当他在另一次进攻开始时发现铁锤队门将出线时，他几乎梅开二度。拉巴伊在中场线发起了精彩的射门，距离不远，他的射门稍稍偏出右门柱。然而，在半场最后一搏中，西汉姆联通过奥莫托耶将比分改写为2-1。在第二节中，拉巴伊渴望更多，他不断考验刘易斯-阿耶斯塔，给对手制造麻烦。我们有很多机会，安德鲁·彭尼不幸没有将头球转向球门，而贾沙伊德·格林伍德则距离近距离只有一步之遥。不过，埃博获得了我们的第三个进球，他从格里姆韦德手中接过球，然后从远处飞出。他的射门发生了偏转并击败了刘易斯-阿耶斯塔，恢复了我们的两球优势。但这不是我们能够保留的。还剩 20 分钟时，我们控球，裘德·朗曼再次将比分差距缩小。蓝军一开始反应很好，格林伍德的大力射门被刘易斯-阿耶斯塔击中横梁，为我们赢得了角球。不幸的是，我们被对手抓住并受到惩罚，奥莫托耶获得了下午的第二个进球，为铁锤帮扳平了比分。扳平比分后不久，我们丢了一个点球，朗曼主罚点球，使我们在比赛中首次落后。我们力争扳平比分，但西汉姆联队在终场哨响前打进第五球，这是我们自九月初以来的首次失利。这场失利让我们跌至第二位，但积 21 分。我们现在落后联盟领头羊两分。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于 11 月 7 日星期六在科巴姆训练场举行英超联赛杯比赛，主场迎战查尔顿竞技队。比赛将于格林威治标准时间上午 11 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔； Riley Ebho (Gabriel Sambou60’)、Dante Waite (Josh Henry 64’) (C)、Jacob Hall、Yisa Alao；艾萨克·巴杜 (Isaac Badu)、杰登·马伦达马 (Jayden Malundama)（比拉尔·沙赫-贝尔库兹 79’）、赫泽·格里姆瓦德 (Heze Grimwade)；易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、贾沙伊德·格林伍德、安德鲁·彭尼（艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里 60’）未上场替补：伊萨戈·席尔瓦、里科·西利得分：格里姆韦德 26、拉巴伊 31、埃博 54 黄牌：马伦达马 45、拉巴伊 68、麦吉尔瓦里 70、巴杜 89 西汉姆联 (4-3-3)：菲利克斯刘易斯-阿耶斯塔；艾萨克·托姆斯、托马斯·乔尼拉（扎克·马戈万 83’）、阿纳尔多·巴托·乌加特、雷恩·史密斯；雷金纳德-雷·阿吉曼 (Reginald-Ray Agyemang)、泰隆·奥莫托耶 (Tyrone Omotoye)、裘德·朗曼 (Oluwadarasimi Akinlolu 87’)；马丁·佩切夫、丘克·奥比、杰夫塔·梅迪恩未上场替补：查尔斯·加兹登、杰克·汤姆林、米切尔·布朗、兰尼·诺布尔、格伦·麦卡杰得分：奥莫托耶 45+2 74、朗曼 71、77、阿金洛鲁 90+4 黄牌：乌盖特 13、乔尼拉 20、马高万 85、梅迪恩 90+4

news.title: Cole Palmer on Rogers' impact against Man United and love for Estevao
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默谈罗杰斯对曼联的影响以及对埃斯特沃的热爱
news.body_en: Cole Palmer was full of praise for his Blues team-mate and friend Morgan Rogers after the duo scored the goals that gave Chelsea victory over Manchester United, and also had words for Estevao Willian after the Brazilian’s return to the starting XI. The Blues secured a 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge in Saturday’s early Premier League kick-off, with Palmer and Rogers helping make up for the absence of striker Joao Pedro by both finding the back of the net. Palmer did so from the penalty spot, getting his 50th Premier League goal for the club on his 105th appearance. Only Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Diego Costa have reached that landmark faster. That came after Rogers had opened the scoring early in the second half. Romeo Lavia won possession in midfield, allowing the England international to pick up the ball and carry it almost the entire length of the Man Utd half, before lifting a deft finish over goalkeeper Senne Lammens. ‘That's what he does, you know,’ Palmer responded with a shrug and a smirk when asked about Rogers’ latest stunning goal for the Blues. ‘He gets the ball between the lines and when he drives he makes things happen. He went all the way himself and it was a great finish.’ With Pedro Neto taking on the centre forward role against the Red Devils, Estevao Willian came into the attack on the wing, making his first Premier League start of the season. The Brazilian made the most of his opportunity, producing several eye-catching moments and finding the back of the net twice, only to have the goals ruled out for offside, the second for the narrowest of VAR calls. ‘He needed to be patient for his moment and he got his moment today,’ Cole said of Estevao’s performance. ‘You could see in moments he was very good. ‘He was unlucky with the offside; I think it was literally a centimetre. But we know the talent he's got and we all love him. So hopefully he can continue like that.’ It was an important three points for Chelsea, dismissing the memories of last week’s loss to Tottenham Hotspur and the midweek Carabao Cup exit at Liverpool on penalties. The result also moves us back into the top four – at least temporarily – and makes it three wins from four matches in the Premier League since the last international break. ‘It was very important to get back to winning ways, obviously after the last defeat, so it's good,’ added Palmer, before explaining what changed in the second half to allow us to break the deadlock and win the game. ‘I just think we were more intense. The chances they had were from us losing the ball, so we tried to play a bit smarter, a bit sharper and not losing the ball as easily, and I think it helped.’ Our next home fixture after the international break sees us face Leeds United. news.body_zh: 在他的蓝军队友兼朋友摩根·罗杰斯进球帮助切尔西战胜曼联后，科尔·帕尔默对他的蓝军队友和朋友摩根·罗杰斯赞不绝口，并在巴西人重返首发阵容后对埃斯特沃·威廉说了一番话。周六英超联赛开赛初期，蓝军在斯坦福桥以 2-0 获胜，帕尔默和罗杰斯双双破门，弥补了前锋若昂·佩德罗的缺席。帕尔默在点球点上做到了这一点，这是他为俱乐部出场的第 105 场英超联赛进球，这是他的第 50 个进球。只有吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和迭戈·科斯塔更快地达到了这一里程碑。这是在罗杰斯下半场早些时候首开纪录之后。罗密欧·拉维亚在中场赢得了控球权，让这位英格兰国脚接球并带球几乎走过了曼联半场，然后灵巧地射门越过了门将塞内·拉门斯。 “你知道，这就是他所做的，”当被问及罗杰斯最近为蓝军打进的令人惊叹的进球时，帕尔默耸耸肩，笑着回答。 “他把球传到两条线之间，当他突破时，他就能让事情发生。他自己一路走来，这是一个伟大的终结。”在对阵红魔的比赛中，佩德罗·内托担任中锋，埃斯特沃·威廉在边路发起进攻，这是他本赛季在英超的首次首发。巴西人充分利用了自己的机会，创造了几个引人注目的时刻，并两次破门，但都因越位而被判无效，这是 VAR 判罚最窄的第二个进球。 “他需要对自己的时刻保持耐心，今天他得到了自己的时刻，”科尔在谈到埃斯特沃的表现时说道。 “你很快就能看出他非常出色。 “他运气不好，越位了；我认为它实际上是一厘米。但我们知道他的才华，我们都爱他。所以希望他能继续这样。”这对切尔西来说是重要的三分，让人们忘记了上周输给托特纳姆热刺队和周中联赛杯点球大战中被利物浦淘汰的记忆。这一结果也让我们重新回到前四——至少是暂时的——并且使我们自上次国际比赛日以来在英超联赛的四场比赛中取得了三场胜利。 “回到胜利之路非常重要，显然是在上次失利之后，所以这很好，”帕尔默补充道，然后解释了下半场发生的变化，让我们打破了僵局并赢得了比赛。 “我只是认为我们更加激烈。他们的机会来自于我们丢球，所以我们试着踢得更聪明、更敏锐，不那么容易丢球，我认为这很有帮助。” 国际比赛日后的下一场主场比赛我们将对阵利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Xabi Alonso reveals half-time instruction that helped Blues defeat Man United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索透露了帮助蓝军击败曼联的半场指导
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso praised the reaction of his Chelsea players against Manchester United after stressing his side needed to ‘win this game with the ball’ at half-time in our 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge. For 45 minutes at Stamford Bridge, little separated the two sides. Possession was evenly shared and while we registered seven shots, three of which were on target, United managed nine, with Mike Penders worked on three occasions. However, after the break, it was a different story. We broke the deadlock in the 50th minute through a fine solo goal from Morgan Rogers and doubled our advantage when Cole Palmer converted from the penalty spot after Lisandro Martinez was sent off for a foul on Wesley Fofana. Naturally, United's reduction to 10 men influenced how the contest played out, but we had 67 per cent of the ball in the second period and fired 11 shots at the United goal. The visitors, in contrast, managed just three. Alonso emphasised after the win that, at the interval, he had stressed to his players the importance of controlling the game through possession, which he felt his players implemented impressively. ‘I think that there were different moments in the game,' the Blues manager said. 'The first half was intense, with momentum for both sides. United had their chances and we were close as well. At half-time, we spoke and the reaction in the second half was better. 'We started quite well, got the lead, and we looked in better control. After it went 2-0 and the red card the context of the game changed, but it was not easy.’ Alonso continued: 'When we spoke at half-time, we said we were going to win this game with the ball, so the improvement has been with the ball. The message was to be better with the ball and to not give away that much. 'We changed some tactical things, but we were more comfortable on the pitch with better control. When you feel better with the ball, normally the better you are defending as well. 'So I think that reaction, that change, has been important for the feeling and the goal as well.’ Alonso opted to start without an orthodox striker against United. Pedro Neto was tasked with leading the line, while Palmer, Rogers and Estevao Willian operated effectively behind the Portuguese international. 'We need to be creative sometimes to find solutions with the players available,' said the Blues manager. 'Pedro has worked really hard in that position. It’s not new to him, linking up with the players around him. 'There were moments [in the first half], but I would say, especially at the start of the second half and what we had spoken about at half-time, the reaction was good.' Our next home fixture after the international break sees us face Leeds United. Secure your place early with Club Chelsea. VIP tickets available now.
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索赞扬了切尔西球员对阵曼联的反应，他在半场结束时强调球队需要“用球赢得这场比赛”，帮助我们2-0战胜斯坦福桥。在斯坦福桥的 45 分钟里，双方几乎没有分出胜负。控球权是平均分配的，虽然我们有 7 次射门，其中 3 次射中目标，但曼联却射门 9 次，而迈克·彭德斯则射门 3 次。然而，休息之后，情况就不同了。第 50 分钟，摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 的精彩个人进球打破了僵局，利桑德罗·马丁内斯 (Lisandro Martinez) 对韦斯利·福法纳 (Wesley Fofana) 犯规被罚下场后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 点球命中，我们的优势扩大了一倍。当然，曼联减少到 10 人的人数影响了比赛的结果，但我们在第二节中控球率为 67%，并向曼联球门射了 11 次射门。相比之下，客队只做到了三分。阿隆索在获胜后强调，在中场休息时，他向球员们强调了通过控球控制比赛的重要性，他认为他的球员们执行得非常出色。 “我认为比赛中有不同的时刻，”蓝军主教练说。 “上半场比赛非常激烈，双方都充满了动力。曼联有机会，我们也很接近。中场休息时，我们进行了交谈，下半场的反应更好了。 “我们开局很好，取得了领先，而且我们看起来控制得更好。在比分变成2-0和红牌之后，比赛的背景发生了变化，但这并不容易。”阿隆索继续说道：“当我们在半场讲话时，我们说我们将用球赢得这场比赛，所以进步是在球方面的。传达的信息是要更好地控球，并且不要放弃太多。 “我们改变了一些战术，但我们在球场上更舒服，控制也更好。当你控球感觉更好时，通常你的防守也会越好。 “所以我认为这种反应、这种变化对于感觉和目标也很重要。”阿隆索选择在对阵曼联的比赛中没有正统前锋的情况下首发。佩德罗·内托的任务是带头，而帕尔默、罗杰斯和埃斯特瓦奥·威廉在这位葡萄牙国脚身后有效地运作。 “我们有时需要发挥创造力，找到现有球员的解决方案，”蓝军主帅说道。 “佩德罗在这个位置上工作非常努力。与周围的球员联系对他来说并不新鲜。 “（上半场）有一些时刻，但我想说，特别是在下半场开始时以及我们在半场休息时谈到的事情，反应很好。”国际比赛日后的下一场主场比赛我们将对阵利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 2-0 曼联
news.body_en: A wonderful individual goal from Morgan Rogers and a Cole Palmer penalty were enough for the Blues to see off 10-man Manchester United at Stamford Bridge and get back to winning ways in the Premier League. The 90 minutes certainly didn't lack drama. Nor goalscoring opportunities. In the opening period, Estevao Willian had the ball in the net for the Blues, as did Matheus Cunha for United. Yet the goals were both ruled out for offside. Xabi Alonso's side took control after the break – and we broke the deadlock in some style. Rogers collected the ball in midfield, breezed past Harry Maguire and Lisandro Martinez, and clipped a finish over Senne Lammens. Our second arrived in the 64th minute, with Palmer converting from 12 yards. The penalty was awarded after a VAR review for Martinez elbowing Wesley Fofana from a corner. The Argentine defender was shown a second yellow card and a red for the incident. With a man and a two-goal advantage, the Blues were certain of the points. We appeared to have added a third goal when Estevao powered a finish into the roof of the net, but he was denied by a VAR review for offside. It didn't change the outcome of the contest, as after two painful defeats in league and cup, we got back on track and claimed the three points. Alonso made four alterations to his side. Marco Palestra made his first Premier League start, Levi Colwill returned to the defence, and Palmer and Estevao Willian were included in the attack. Malo Gusto, Maxence Lacroix, Jordan Henderson, who was absent through illness, and Danny Welbeck dropped out of the starting XI The opening 45 minutes ebbed and flowed. The Blues fashioned chances; United did the same. Sustained pressure was fleeting. Estevao fired the first warning shot of the afternoon. The winger cut inside onto his stronger right foot and whipped a shot toward the far corner. Senne Lammens was beaten, but the ball flew wide. United responded with an attempt of their own. A neat move around our penalty box saw Bruno Fernandes tee up former Blue Andrey Santos, and the midfielder guided a shot narrowly wide. Throughout the opening period, opportunities arrived via counter-attacks, and in the 14th minute, one led to what appeared to be our opening goal. Estevao launched a break and fed Pedro Neto, who forced a save from Lammens. The Brazilian converted the rebound from close range, only for the offside flag to be raised. From United's next attack, launched following a Chelsea corner, Bryan Mbeumo played an expertly weighted crossfield pass to Fernandes. The Portuguese controlled but skewed his shot high and wide. Fernandes looked to return the favour to Mbeumo soon after, flashing the ball across the Blues' six-yard box. Yet the United forward couldn't react to finish. It was a let-off. A flurry of United chances followed. First, Mike Penders reacted well to push clear a powerful low shot from Amad Diallo, and Josh Acheampong did well on the rebound to deny Matheus Cunha. Amad then forced Penders into a near-post stop. A key moment in the game arrived ten minutes before the interval. Maguire met a back-post corner and Matheus Cunha was able to nod the ball past Penders from close range. The United forward celebrated, as did his team-mates. Then came a VAR review: the Brazilian was offside and the goal was ruled out. United continued to threaten, and Amad twice came close either side of Moises Caicedo striking the base of the post from an Estevao corner. Wesley Fofana denied the United winger with an excellent block, and from his second attempt, the winger missed a one-on-one with Penders. The final opportunities of the opening period were ours. Neto first robbed Maguire in his own defensive third, broke into the box and tried to finish. Unfortunately, his far-post attempt flew wide. Estevao then drew a save from Lammens to draw the half to a close. Alonso opted against any substitutions at the break – and five minutes after the restart was rewarded as the Blues broke the deadlock. It was quite the goal. The impressive Romeo Lavia did excellently to win back possession in midfield and laid a pass to Rogers, who began to advance 35 yards from goal. The England international wasn't challenged, then eased beyond Maguire and Martinez into the box, and lifted a deft finish over Lammens. With momentum and confidence, the Blues then took – and did not relinquish – control. It was one-way traffic, with Penders hardly tested. Lammens was far busier. He first had to deny a header from Neto, and then had to be alert to avoid being caught out by an Estevao corner destined for the net. Pressure was building on the United goal. We earned a corner that Estevao delivered to the back post and, under pressure from Martinez, Fofana fell to the ground holding his face. Another corner was awarded, but VAR intervened. Referee Peter Bankes went to the monitor and, following a review, awarded a penalty. Martinez was shown a second yellow card and then a red. United were down to ten – and moments later were two goals behind as Palmer powered his spot-kick through Lammens. From then on, it was clear the three points would be staying at Stamford Bridge. Only the final scoreline was uncertain. The Blues supporters did have the chance to celebrate a third goal as, after winning the ball back in United's half, Palmer slipped a pass through to Estevao, who advanced and drilled a shot into the roof of the net. The Brazilian celebrated with his team-mates and Alonso, but following a delayed VAR review, the goal was ruled out for a marginal offside. Estevao was determined to get his name on the score-sheet, though, and twice forced Lammens into good stops. The second was a powerful effort that required a full-length stop. Alonso shuffled his pack as the half progressed. Pep Chavarria was introduced for Palestra; Malo Gusto, Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck came on late for Caicedo, Estevao and Neto. Ten minutes were added. They didn't pass without incident. First, Mbeumo thumped a shot against the crossbar from 20 yards before the Blues cleared. Replays showed Penders got the merest of touches to deflect it onto the woodwork. An impressive run forward from Acheampong and a neat pass from Chavarria then presented Palmer with a chance, but he curled his effort over. Barco then missed the final chance of the contest, firing wide from close range after a Gusto cross. The Blues have a full week to prepare for our next top-flight fixture, which comes next weekend as we travel to Sunderland on 8 November. Our next home fixture is against Leeds United in the Premier League on Saturday 21 November and you can secure your place at Stamford Bridge early with Club Chelsea, as VIP tickets are available here now. 码处射门。马丁内斯在角球中肘击韦斯利·福法纳，经VAR审查后判罚点球。阿根廷后卫因这一事件被出示第二张黄牌和一张红牌。凭借一人之力和两球优势，蓝军稳取积分。当埃斯特沃将球射入网顶时，我们似乎又进了第三个进球，但他被 VAR 分钟时长时长。蓝军创造了机会；曼联也做了同样的事情。持续的压力转瞬即逝。埃斯特沃开了下午的第一声警告枪。这位边锋用他更强的右脚切入内线，向远角射门。塞内·拉门斯被打，但皮球偏出。曼联也做出了回应。布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在禁区附近巧妙的移动，与前蓝军安德烈·桑托斯开球，这名中场球员的射门稍稍偏出。整个开场阶段，我们都通过反击获得了机会，第14分钟，我们就取得了看似首开纪录的进球。埃斯特沃发起突破，传球给佩德罗·内托，后者迫使拉门斯做出扑救。巴西人近距离反弹，但越位旗被举起。曼联在切尔西开出角球后发动下一次进攻，布莱恩·姆博莫（Bryan Cunha）。阿马德随后迫使彭德斯在近门柱处停下。比赛的关键时刻在中场休息前十分钟到来。马奎尔接到后门柱角球，马修斯·库尼亚近距离将球顶过彭德斯。曼联前锋和他的队友们都庆祝了。随后VAR审核：巴西人越位，进球无效。曼联继续制造威胁，阿马德两次逼近莫伊塞斯·凯塞多接埃斯特沃角球击中门柱底部。韦斯利·福法纳以出色的拦截挡出了曼联边锋的防守，但在第二次尝试中，这名边锋错过了与彭德斯的一对一。开局阶段的最后机会是我们的。内托首先在自己的防守三分中抢断了马奎尔，闯入禁区并试图完成射门。不幸的是，他的远门柱射门偏出。埃斯特沃随后被拉门斯扑出，半场比赛结束。阿隆索在中场休息时选择不进行任何换人，而在比赛重新开始五分钟后，蓝军打破了僵局。这确实是目标。令人印象深刻的罗密欧·拉维亚在中场出色地夺回控球权，并将球传给罗杰斯，罗杰斯开始向球门推进 news.title: Xabi Alonso explains Jordan Henderson absence against Man United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释乔丹·亨德森缺席对阵曼联的比赛
news.body_en: Ahead of facing Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, Xabi Alonso explained why Jordan Henderson isn’t involved and why now was the right time for Estevao Willian to come into the starting XI. Our manager made four changes to his line-up for today’s Premier League fixture, one of them enforced by the absence of Henderson from the matchday squad to face the Red Devils. ‘He's ill,’ revealed Alonso. ‘There’s no injury, but he was not feeling well yesterday and today had a fever in the morning, so he was not feeling good enough to come with the team.’ In another of the changes, Alonso has called on Estevao, the Brazilian making his first league start of the 2026/27 season. When asked why now was the right time, our manager’s response was simple: ‘Because he's ready. ‘Because he's been preparing and training well to be ready any time, whenever he's needed, and today he's needed and we hope that he enjoys his game, and he can have a good impact.’ Estevao looks set to line up in a four-pronged Chelsea attack, alongside Pedro Neto, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. However, when it comes to which of those forwards will lead the line as the central striker, Alonso is keeping his cards close to his chest. ‘It's too early to tell,’ the Spaniard said with a grin. ‘It’s too early, so we will see. It could be Morgan, but we have options.’
news.body_zh: 在斯坦福桥对阵曼联之前，哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么乔丹·亨德森没有参与其中，以及为什么现在是埃斯特沃·威廉进入首发阵容的最佳时机。我们的主教练对今天英超联赛的阵容进行了四项调整，其中一项是因为亨德森缺席对阵红魔的比赛阵容。 “他病了，”阿隆索透露。 “没有受伤，但他昨天感觉不舒服，今天早上又发烧了，所以他感觉不太好，无法随队参赛。”在另一个变化中，阿隆索给巴西人埃斯特沃打了电话，这位巴西人在2026/27赛季的联赛中首次首发。当被问及为什么现在是合适的时机时，我们的经理的回答很简单：“因为他已经准备好了。” “因为他一直在做好准备和训练，随时准备好，无论何时需要他，今天我们需要他，我们希望他享受比赛，他能产生良好的影响。”埃斯特沃看起来将与佩德罗·内托、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起参加切尔西的四管齐下的进攻。然而，当谈到哪位前锋将担任中锋时，阿隆索则守口如瓶。 “现在下结论还为时过早，”西班牙人笑着说道。 “现在还太早，所以我们拭目以待。可能是摩根，但我们有选择。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Manchester United

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has opted to make four changes to his Chelsea starting XI for this afternoon's Premier League meeting with Manchester United at Stamford Bridge. We return to top-flight action after midweek Carabao Cup heartache and host a Man United side that have won just one of their eight league fixtures this term. Mike Penders continues in goal for the Blues after an impressive showing at Liverpool on Wednesday night, and is set to be protected by a back four of Josh Acheampong, Wesley Fofana, Levi Colwill and Marco Palestra, who makes his first Premier League start. Moises Caicedo captains the Blues and continues in midfield alongside Romeo Lavia. Jordan Henderson is not in the matchday squad. Estevao Willian comes into the Chelsea attack, Cole Palmer returns after serving a one-match suspension, and Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto start once again. news.title: Wieke Kaptein on her improvement this season and key to Blues' strong start
news.title_zh: Wieke Kaptein 谈她本赛季的进步以及蓝军强劲开局的关键
news.body_en: Wieke Kaptein has been a key cog in Sonia Bompastor’s side this season, often doing the unseen work that has given the Blues a platform on which to record victories. On Wednesday evening, Kaptein provided assists for both of our goals in our UEFA Women’s Champions League victory against Roma, and then claimed the Player of the Match trophy. It was the second individual accolade claimed by the Dutch international after our league phase matches; the first came after she scored a brilliant strike in our 1-0 victory over Austria Vienna. And although she was pleased with her performance at Plough Lane, she typically shifted the praise onto her team-mates. ‘It's a nice stadium. I like playing there,’ she told us. ‘Of course, I had two assists against Roma. But I think one of the defenders should have it, to be honest. Kadeisha (Buchanan), Lucy (Bronze), and Veerle (Buurman) did very well to get the clean sheet, and I think that's just as important as assists or the goals. ‘It’s nice to get the assists, though. I have a really good connection with Ellie (Carpenter). When she came in, we found each other very easily. Of course, I can do a lot of things better. I could hold the ball sometimes a little bit better, but everyone can learn.’ Kaptein speaks of a reset in the summer where she evaluated her own performances from last season and worked hard to improve. Her motivation was not only to earn more minutes, but also to contribute to the collective effort and allow others to shine. ‘It is my game, to be honest,’ she continues. ‘My team-mates see what I do for them, and that’s the only thing that’s important to me. My main strength is to make other players play at their best. ‘I'm on a good run right now: I feel good. I think if you see my statistics, I recover a lot of balls. I also like making key passes. I really like it when my teammates are feeling good on the pitch. That’s when I feel good on the pitch. ‘In the second half of last season, I didn't play as much, so I did a lot of work in pre-season. I work really hard and look at myself. I like to do the unselfish things in a game for the team, and I think that helps other players show their strengths. ‘I try to do that and also play my own game, making assists, and I hope to score a little bit more too. I want to be as important as I can be and help the team as much as I can. We have incredible midfielders this season. I think it's good; it keeps everyone sharp!’ While Kaptein has started all but one of our games this term, she sees the value of those brought on as substitutes. In our last two matches against Crystal Palace and Roma, those introduced have scored key second-half goals to help us to victory. The 21-year-old also points to the 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. The game was level at 1-1 until a triple substitution just before the hour mark, another example of when the changes have worked to good effect. ‘I think the key, to be honest, is that we’re performing really well as a team,’ she explains. ‘The starters and the substitutes are just as important. It doesn't really matter who plays, but usually our substitutions make a difference in the game, and I think that's what has changed games a lot this season. ‘You could see it against Tottenham; they played well against us for 60 minutes, and then we brought our substitutes on, and we scored five goals. We're helping each other. Everyone wants to fight for each other, and I think that's really changed this year.’ We travel to Charlton tomorrow to face a side yet to score a point in their seven matches since being promoted from the second tier last summer. But Kaptein knows only too well that the Blues must not be complacent, no matter who we come up against. ‘They are fighting for points,’ she says. ‘So we need to be ready for them. We need to be consistent and focus on our own performances. We don't need to score in the first or second minute. We need to get the goal and then keep going.'
news.body_zh: 维克·卡普坦本赛季一直是索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔队中的关键人物，经常做一些看不见的工作，为蓝军提供了一个记录胜利的平台。周三晚上，在我们战胜罗马的欧洲女足冠军联赛中，卡普坦为我们的两个进球提供了助攻，然后获得了本场比赛的最佳球员奖杯。这是荷兰国脚在联赛阶段比赛后获得的第二个个人荣誉；第一次是在我们1-0战胜奥地利维也纳的比赛中她打进一球后。尽管她对自己在犁巷的表现感到满意，但她通常会将赞扬转嫁给她的队友。 ‘这是一个不错的体育场。我喜欢在那里玩，”她告诉我们。 “当然，在对阵罗马的比赛中我有两次助攻。但说实话，我认为一名后卫应该拥有它。卡德伊沙（布坎南）、露西（铜牌）和维尔勒（布尔曼）在零失球方面表现出色，我认为这与助攻或进球同样重要。 “不过，得到助攻还是很高兴的。我和艾莉（卡彭特饰）的关系非常好。当她进来时，我们很容易就找到了对方。当然，我可以把很多事情做得更好。有时我可以更好地控球，但每个人都可以学习。”卡普坦谈到了夏天的重置，她评估了自己上赛季的表现，并努力提高。她的动机不仅是为了赢得更多的上场时间，也是为了为集体努力做出贡献，让别人发光发热。 “说实话，这是我的游戏，”她继续说道。 “我的队友们看到我为他们所做的一切，这对我来说是唯一重要的事情。我的主要优势是让其他球员发挥出最佳水平。 “我现在状态很好：我感觉很好。我想如果你看我的统计数据，你会发现我收回了很多球。我也喜欢进行关键传球。当我的队友在场上感觉良好时，我真的很喜欢。那是我在球场上感觉良好的时候。 “上赛季后半段，我的出场次数不多，所以季前赛我做了很多工作。我真的很努力工作并审视自己。我喜欢在比赛中为球队做无私的事情，我认为这有助于其他球员展示他们的优势。 “我努力做到这一点，同时也打出自己的比赛，助攻，我也希望能多得分一点。我想尽我所能，尽可能地帮助球队。本赛季我们拥有令人难以置信的中场球员。我认为这很好；虽然卡普坦本学期除了一场比赛之外都首发了，但她看到了替补球员的价值。在我们过去两场对阵水晶宫和罗马的比赛中，引进的球员在下半场打进了关键进球，帮助我们取得了胜利。这位21岁的球员还提到了在斯坦福桥以6-2战胜托特纳姆热刺队的比赛。比赛一直是 1-1 平，直到一小时前进行三次换人，这是这些变化发挥良好效果的另一个例子。 “说实话，我认为关键是我们作为一个团队表现得非常好，”她解释道。 “首发球员和替补球员同样重要。谁上场并不重要，但通常我们的换人会在比赛中发挥作用，我认为这就是本赛季比赛发生很大变化的原因。 “你可以在对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中看到这一点；他们在对阵我们的 60 分钟内表现出色，然后我们换上了替补，我们进了 5 个球。我们互相帮助。每个人都想为彼此而战，我认为今年情况确实发生了变化。明天我们将前往查尔顿，对阵一支自去年夏天从乙级联赛升级以来在七场比赛中尚未取得一分的球队。但卡普坦非常清楚，无论我们面对谁，蓝军都不能自满。 “他们正在为积分而战，”她说。 ‘所以我们需要为他们做好准备。我们需要保持一致并专注于我们自己的表现。我们不需要在第一分钟或第二分钟就进球。我们需要实现目标，然后继续前进。”

news.title: Jordan Henderson on 'big moments' and playing alongside Moises Caicedo
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森谈“重要时刻”并与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并肩作战
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson talks about finding his feet at Chelsea in an exclusive interview with the matchday programme for today’s game against Manchester United. The midfielder hit the ground running with a brace on his home debut earlier this month, and speaks about the sensation of seeing the ball hit the back of the net less than two minutes into the 5-1 win over Bournemouth. 'You can never prepare for stuff like that,' he says. 'It was quite emotional for me because I’ve been out for so long and then coming to start at Chelsea and having to wait a little bit. 'So it was a big moment for me personally, but it was just something that I’d dreamt of over the few months that I’ve been here… that I could get a good start, and thankfully it happened in the first couple of minutes.' He also talks in depth about his midfield role under Xabi Alonso and the joy of playing alongside Moises Caicedo. 'I think it’s been a little bit different to what I’ve done in the past, playing a little bit of a double pivot with Moi,' he says. 'But when you play with somebody like Moi, he makes it so easy. 'He’s a world-class midfielder, probably one of the best in the world in his position. So for me it’s trying to help him and have a good relationship with him as much as possible, and he’s an incredible player to play with, which makes it easier for me.' This is our last home game before Remembrance Sunday and the programme pays tribute to the Chelsea players who lost their lives in the two world wars, while there is a special Legacy feature on events at the club during the Second World War. We also have all the info you need ahead of a massive match with Manchester United, and as it’s our 200th game against the Red Devils, we’ve picked out five outstanding Chelsea victories from among them. Meanwhile, our Greatest Games feature focuses on the Blues’ unforgettable 5-0 win in this fixture in October 1999. With all the latest from around the club, plus columns from the manager and the captain, we’ve got your matchday covered. news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在今天对阵曼联的比赛日节目中接受独家采访时谈到了在切尔西站稳脚跟的事情。这位中场球员在本月早些时候的主场首秀中梅开二度，并谈到了在5-1战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中不到两分钟时看到皮球入网的感觉。 “你永远无法为这样的事情做好准备，”他说。 “这对我来说非常激动，因为我已经缺阵这么久了，然后来到切尔西首发，不得不等待一段时间。 “所以这对我个人来说是一个重要的时刻，但这只是我来这里的几个月里一直梦想的事情……我可以有一个好的开始，值得庆幸的是，这在最初的几分钟内就发生了。”他还深入谈论了他在哈维·阿隆索麾下的中场角色，以及与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并肩作战的乐趣。 “我认为这与我过去所做的有点不同，我和莫伊一起打了一点双枢轴，”他说。 “但是当你和莫伊这样的人一起踢球时，他会让一切变得如此简单。 “他是一名世界级的中场球员，在他的位置上可能是世界上最好的中场球员之一。所以对我来说，就是尽可能帮助他并与他建立良好的关系，他是一位令人难以置信的球员，这对我来说更容易。”这是我们在阵亡将士纪念日之前的最后一场主场比赛，该节目向在两次世界大战中丧生的切尔西球员致敬，同时还有一个关于第二次世界大战期间俱乐部活动的特殊遗产专题。我们还拥有您在与曼联的一场大型比赛之前所需的所有信息，由于这是我们对阵红魔的第 200 场比赛，我们从其中挑选了 5 场出色的切尔西胜利。与此同时，我们的“最伟大的比赛”专题聚焦于 1999 年 10 月蓝军在这场比赛中令人难忘的 5-0 胜利。通过俱乐部的所有最新消息，以及主教练和队长的专栏，我们为您提供了比赛日的报道。从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的官方出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.title: Xabi Alonso explains why Jorrel Hato will miss Manchester United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么乔雷尔·哈托会错过曼联
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Jorrel Hato will miss tomorrow’s match against Manchester United and discussed how the Blues can get the best out of our attacking talent on the big stage. Hato has been named in Alonso’s starting XI for six of our eight Premier League fixtures this season, but was absent for our midweek Carabao Cup trip to Liverpool. The Dutch defender will also not feature when Manchester United visit Stamford Bridge for tomorrow's early kick-off, with Alonso confirming the nature of the 20-year-old's issue. ‘How long, we don't know, but he’s not available for tomorrow,’ our manager confirmed in his pre-match press conference on Friday afternoon. ‘He has a back problem and he's not feeling okay for tomorrow.’ One player who is available to face United is Cole Palmer, who returns after serving his one-match suspension on Wednesday. Palmer inspired a brilliant late comeback win over the Red Devils two years ago, when his hat-trick helped secure a dramatic 4-3 victory which will live long in the memory. Chelsea against Manchester United is always a big occasion, with two of English football’s most successful clubs go head-to-head, and Alonso went explained what the Blues need to do to help Palmer and his fellow attacking players shine once again in the intensity and pressure of a big-game atmosphere. ‘For sure, I think that everyone needs to show their best level in all the games, but in the big ones, sometimes it's harder because the opponent has good quality, because of the quality of the game,’ he added. ‘We need to support the attackers, so that they get the ball in the right place, so that they are involved, so that they are connected to the game and with the rest of the team. So we are all just focused on playing a good game tomorrow.’ Of course, Alonso is no stranger to big games in the Premier League, both as a player and a manager. During his time representing Liverpool, he was involved in many high-pressure encounters with Manchester United, in many of which he came up against fellow midfielder - and current United manager - Michael Carrick. ‘They were top games when I was at Liverpool, and they were intense games,’ the Spaniard recalled. ‘That United team was a top one and I remember playing against Michael. He was one of the finest English midfielders of that time. I really enjoyed playing against him before, at Spurs, and after at United with Paul Scholes. They had a fantastic midfield partnership. ‘So I really enjoyed playing against them and probably they made me a better player.’ Don't miss out! news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么乔雷尔·哈托将缺席明天对阵曼联的比赛，并讨论了蓝军如何在大舞台上充分发挥我们的进攻天赋。哈托在本赛季八场英超比赛中的六场中被列入阿隆索的首发阵容，但缺席了周中对阵利物浦的卡拉宝杯之旅。这位荷兰后卫也不会在曼联明天客场造访斯坦福桥的比赛中出场，阿隆索证实了这位20岁球员问题的性质。 “我们不知道要多久，但他明天不能上场，”我们的主教练在周五下午的赛前新闻发布会上证实。 “他背部有问题，明天感觉不太好。”科尔·帕尔默是一名可以对阵曼联的球员，他在周三停赛一场后回归。两年前，帕尔默带领球队在最后时刻逆转战胜红魔，当时他的帽子戏法帮助球队以 4-3 的戏剧性胜利，这将永远留在人们的记忆中。切尔西对阵曼联始终是一个重要时刻，英格兰足球最成功的两家具乐部将进行正面交锋，阿隆索解释了蓝军需要做些什么来帮助帕尔默和他的进攻队员在激烈和压力大的比赛气氛中再次闪耀。 “当然，我认为每个人都需要在所有比赛中展现出自己的最佳水平，但在大型比赛中，有时会更困难，因为对手的实力很好，因为比赛的质量，”他补充道。 “我们需要支持进攻球员，让他们把球传到正确的位置，让他们参与其中，让他们与比赛以及球队的其他球员保持联系。所以我们都只专注于明天打一场精彩的比赛。”当然，无论作为球员还是教练，阿隆索对英超联赛的大型比赛并不陌生。在代表利物浦效力期间，他与曼联进行了多次高压交锋，其中很多都是与中场队友、现任曼联主教练迈克尔·卡里克对抗。 “当我在利物浦时，那是顶级比赛，而且是激烈的比赛，”西班牙人回忆道。 “那支曼联队是一支顶级球队，我记得和迈克尔对阵。他是当时最优秀的英格兰中场球员之一。我真的很喜欢在之前、在热刺和保罗·斯科尔斯在曼联与他交手。他们有着出色的中场合作关系。 “所以我真的很喜欢和他们比赛，也许他们让我成为了一名更好的球员。” 不要错过！普通门票已售完，因此观看切尔西在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的唯一方式就是购买切尔西招待套餐。剩余数量有限。立即预订招待。

news.title: Xabi Alonso: ‘I want to see the good version of us’
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索：“我想看到我们的优秀版本”
news.body_en: At the end of a demanding week, Xabi Alonso has called on his Chelsea players to return to winning ways by ‘playing with personality’ against Manchester United and concentrating on what we can control. Last weekend, we suffered a rare home defeat to Tottenham Hotspur and then exited the Carabao Cup at Anfield on Wednesday, losing on penalties after a hard-fought 1-1 draw. The outcomes of the two games were disappointing, but Alonso saw improvements from his side in midweek. Now he wants to see us build on those foundations for Manchester United's visit in tomorrow's lunchtime kick-off. ‘It's a big one,’ the Blues manager said in his pre-match press conference. ‘We didn’t have much time to prepare, but it’s really important after the last home game that we keep winning games, and we have this winning feeling. ‘We need to have good control, good emotional control, be comfortable, be intense, control their quality. ‘They have many players that get close to each other when they have good connections. We need to be aware of that and we need to be brave and play our game with personality. The first goal...it's going to be important as well.’ Alonso would have ideally liked a longer turnaround between Wednesday night’s game on Merseyside and the return of Premier League action. However, he insisted his players will be ‘in the best possible condition for tomorrow’ physically and mentally. Alonso explained that part of his pre-match discussions with his squad have centred on ignoring the outside noise regarding tomorrow's visitors, who are fresh off 4-1 and 3-0 losses to Como and Bournemouth respectively. Our manager hopes last weekend’s result serves as a learning in that respect. He said: ‘It doesn't change the situation. We need to prepare the same way. We control what we can control. It's our preparation, our decisions, our mindset, knowing that they're a good team. ‘Against Tottenham, we said the table doesn't matter. At this moment, it doesn't matter. It's too early to tell. And United have a good squad; they have good players and a good manager. It’s going to be a tough game, and we’ll have a good version of us to win the game. ‘This is going to be the journey. We'll have good moments, tough moments, but we need to learn from them. I saw a better version of us on Wednesday than I saw on Saturday, even if the result wasn’t good in either, but I want to see more of the good version of us.’ Don't miss out! news.body_zh: 在艰难的一周结束时，哈维·阿隆索呼吁他的切尔西球员在对阵曼联的比赛中“发挥个性”并专注于我们能控制的事情，从而重返胜利之路。上周末，我们在主场罕见地输给了托特纳姆热刺队，随后周三在安菲尔德举行的卡拉宝杯比赛中，经过一场苦战，1-1战平后，在点球大战中失利。两场比赛的结果令人失望，但阿隆索在周中看到了球队的进步。现在，他希望看到我们为曼联在明天午餐时间的开球中造访奠定这些基础。 “这是一件大事，”蓝军主帅在赛前新闻发布会上说道。 “我们没有太多时间准备，但在上一场主场比赛之后，我们继续赢得比赛，这非常重要，我们有这种获胜的感觉。 “我们需要有良好的控制力，良好的情绪控制力，保持舒适，保持紧张，控制他们的质量。 “他们有很多球员，当他们拥有良好的联系时，他们会变得很亲近。我们需要意识到这一点，我们需要勇敢并以个性来玩我们的游戏。第一个进球......它也很重要。阿隆索理想地希望在周三晚上默西塞德郡的比赛和英超联赛回归之间有更长的周转时间。然而，他坚称他的球员将在身体和精神上“为明天保持最佳状态”。阿隆索解释说，他与球队的赛前讨论的一部分集中在忽略有关明天客队的外界噪音，他们刚刚分别以 4-1 和 3-0 输给科莫和伯恩茅斯。我们的经理希望上周末的结果可以作为这方面的一个教训。他说：“这不会改变情况。我们需要以同样的方式做好准备。我们控制我们能控制的事情。这是我们的准备、我们的决定、我们的心态，我们知道他们是一支优秀的球队。 “对阵托特纳姆热刺，我们说积分榜并不重要。此时此刻，一切都不重要了。现在说还为时过早。曼联拥有一支优秀的阵容；他们有优秀的球员和优秀的教练。这将是一场艰难的比赛，我们将拥有出色的表现来赢得比赛。 ‘这将是一段旅程。我们会经历美好的时刻，也会经历艰难的时刻，但我们需要从中学习。周三我看到了比周六更好的我们，即使结果都不好，但我想看到更多更好的我们。不要错过！普通门票已售完，因此观看切尔西在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的唯一方式就是购买切尔西招待套餐。剩余数量有限。立即预订招待

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Charlton press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在查尔顿赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash against Charlton on Sunday, and here are the key talking points from what the Blues head coach said. After confirming that Lexi Potter would not feature against Charlton, Bompastor explained that the 20-year-old would likely be back in action quickly after suffering a minor knee injury in the final stages of the win against Roma. The head coach has made full use of her substitutes to give the players the rest they need this season, and we remain unbeaten in all competitions after 12 games played. Here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Friday. 'It's important. When you have that ability, your team is a little bit more unpredictable. In the different teams I have coached, in my previous club as well, we always had a lot of players involved in scoring goals. 'The way we want to perform and play, it helps to get everyone involved and take some responsibility for scoring goals. I'm happy with that because sometimes it's difficult to rely on one person. If you do have a player who is on fire and scores every week and every game, it's also positive.' 'We come into every game really well prepared. We know in this league every game is tough, and you can lose points against anyone. We want to put in a good performance to get the three points. 'If we want to compete and stay at the top for as long as possible, we need to approach every game with a lot of respect for every opponent.' 'We reflected a lot after last season, and we knew exactly the things we wanted to improve. Having players performing at their best level helps a lot. 'If you look at the profiles we have in the squad, they are top-class players. That's in terms of their mentality, the desire to defend, the leadership they have, the communication they bring on the pitch, but also the quality they bring individually in winning the duels. 'It's about managing the backline and the whole team, managing the depth, the height of the block on the pitch; all these details are really well managed. We still have room for improvement, but I'm really pleased with the individual performances in the backline.' 'We are really happy to have Katie with us. Her leadership on and off the pitch is unbelievable. Working with Katie is really easy. 'She always wants to work hard. She always leads by example, and you can really have honest and direct conversations with her. 'Her performances on the pitch, how she is with the team and in the environment shows she always thinks first about the team and how she can help the team to be the best.' 'In the last two games, I was convinced I had to change the profiles of players coming into the game. That's why against Palace, I felt on the left side, having a player like Sandy (Baltimore) who is really comfortable in tight spaces and crossing from no space, I was convinced it was the right thing to do from what I could observe in the first half. 'In the game against Roma, I was also really convinced about bringing Ellie (Carpenter) in from half-time. It's always a tough balance because sometimes if you give some more minutes to the players on the pitch in the first half, maybe they will find their feet and deliver something more efficient. 'In the second half, sometimes spaces are more open because the other team is more fatigued. But when you have quality on the bench, you also need to trust the players who can come in and impact the game.'
news.body_zh: 周日，我们的女足超级联赛对阵查尔顿之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的关键谈话要点。在确认莱克西·波特不会在对阵查尔顿的比赛中出场后，邦帕斯特解释说，这位20岁的球员在战胜罗马的最后阶段膝盖受了轻伤，很可能会很快回归比赛。主教练充分利用了替补球员，让球员得到了本赛季所需的休息，我们在12场比赛后各项赛事中保持不败。以下是我们主教练周五赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点。 '这很重要。当你拥有这种能力时，你的团队就会变得更加不可预测。在我执教过的不同球队中，以及在我以前的俱乐部中，我们总是有很多球员参与进球。 “我们想要的表现和比赛方式，有助于让每个人都参与进来，并为进球承担一些责任。我对此很高兴，因为有时很难依赖一个人。如果你确实有一名火热的球员，每周、每场比赛都能进球，这也是积极的。” “我们每场比赛都做好了充分的准备。我们知道在这个联盟中每场比赛都很艰难，你可能会在对阵任何人时失分。我们希望拿出好的表现来拿到三分。 “如果我们想尽可能长时间地参与竞争并保持领先地位，我们需要以尊重每一位对手的方式对待每场比赛。” “上赛季结束后我们进行了很多反思，我们清楚地知道我们想要改进的地方。让球员发挥出最佳水平有很大帮助。 “如果你看看我们球队的资料，你会发现他们都是顶级球员。这包括他们的心态、防守的欲望、他们的领导能力、他们在球场上的沟通，以及他们在赢得对决中的个人素质。 “这是关于管理后防线和整个球队，管理球场上的深度和高度；所有这些细节都管理得很好。我们还有改进的空间，但我对后防线的个人表现非常满意。” “我们真的很高兴凯蒂和我们在一起。她在球场内外的领导力令人难以置信。和凯蒂一起工作真的很容易。 “她总是想努力工作。她总是以身作则，你真的可以与她进行诚实和直接的对话。 “她在球场上的表现、她与球队的相处以及在环境中的表现都表明她总是首先考虑球队以及她如何帮助球队做到最好。” “在过去的两场比赛中，我确信我必须改变进入比赛的球员的资料。这就是为什么对阵水晶宫的比赛，我感觉在左边，有像桑迪（巴尔的摩）这样的球员，他在狭小的空间里非常舒服，并且从无空间传中，从我上半场观察到的情况来看，我确信这是正确的做法。 “在对阵罗马的比赛中，我也非常确信在中场休息时将埃莉（卡彭特）带上场。这始终是一个艰难的平衡，因为有时如果你在上半场给场上的球员更多的时间，也许他们会找到自己的位置并提供更高效的东西。 “在下半场，有时空间会更空，因为对方球队更疲劳。但当你的替补席上有足够的实力时，你还需要信任那些能够上场并影响比赛的球员。”

news.title: Bompastor updates on Lexi Potter ahead of Charlton
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯特在查尔顿之前更新了莱克西·波特的情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was pleased to confirm Lexi Potter’s knee injury is not serious, and while the midfielder will likely miss the game against Charlton, our head coach hopes to have her back before too long. The Blues face yet another London derby this weekend, this time against newly-promoted Charlton at The Valley. We sit at the top of the WSL table after seven games, equal on points with Manchester City on 19, but with a superior goal difference. We come into the game off the back of the midweek European victory against Roma. The only disappointment on the night was an injury picked up by Potter late on, but Bompastor reported it is not as bad as it could have been. ‘Lexi did an MRI yesterday evening and nothing major from her knee, so it’s good news,’ said the head coach at her media conference at Cobham. ‘She probably won’t be available for this weekend. We just need things to settle down a little bit, but nothing major. ‘We will see how she improves next week, and if she can be available for the Everton game.’ So far this season Bompastor has benefitted from having a largely fit squad to pick from, in contrast to the 2025/26 campaign. Managing players’ loads is of course a crucial component of her management, and she explained why the quality on display in the Women’s Super League and the Champions League makes finding that balance difficult. ‘You can’t really have the mindset to rotate your team in the league, even when sometimes you’ve played in the Champions League in midweek,’ she explained. ‘The level of both competitions doesn’t always give you that opportunity. In France you could easily play in the league with a really young team against some teams and you will still get a result. ‘Here it’s about making sure the recovery between the games is appropriate and as efficient as possible, because the players need to perform at a really good level every three days. When you play for a club like Chelsea that’s what happens. She added: ‘The players need to be robust, but as a manager you need to find opportunities to sometimes give them that rest, mental and physical rest, because they are not machines – maybe Lucy Bronze is the only one! ‘But they need some break. Off the back of this summer, the players didn’t have a big tournament, and certainly here at Chelsea availability has been a lot better than in past years.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托很高兴地确认莱克西·波特的膝盖伤势并不严重，虽然这位中场球员可能会缺席对阵查尔顿的比赛，但我们的主教练希望她很快就能回归。本周末，蓝军将迎来另一场伦敦德比，这次是在山谷球场对阵升班马查尔顿。七场比赛过后，我们在 WSL 积分榜上位居榜首，积分与第 19 场的曼城持平，但净胜球优势更大。我们在周中欧战战胜罗马后进入比赛。当晚唯一令人失望的是波特在晚些时候受伤，但邦帕斯特报告说情况并没有想象的那么严重。 “莱克西昨天晚上做了核磁共振检查，膝盖没有什么大问题，所以这是个好消息，”主教练在科巴姆举行的媒体发布会上说。 “她这个周末可能没空。我们只是需要让事情安定下来，但没什么大不了的。 “我们将看看她下周的进步情况，以及她是否可以参加埃弗顿的比赛。”与2025/26赛季相比，本赛季到目前为止，邦帕斯托受益于拥有一支基本健康的阵容可供选择。管理球员的负荷当然是她管理的一个重要组成部分，她解释了为什么女足超级联赛和冠军联赛中所表现出的质量使得找到这种平衡变得困难。 “你不可能真正有在联赛中轮换球队的心态，即使有时你在周中参加了冠军联赛，”她解释道。 “两项比赛的水平并不总是能给你这样的机会。在法国，你可以很容易地在联赛中与一支非常年轻的球队对阵一些球队，但你仍然会得到结果。 “这里的重点是确保比赛之间的恢复适当且尽可能高效，因为球员需要每三天发挥出非常好的水平。当你为切尔西这样的俱乐部效力时，就会发生这种情况。她补充道：“球员们需要坚强，但作为一名主教练，你需要找到机会让他们有时得到休息，精神和身体上的休息，因为他们不是机器——也许露西·青铜是唯一的机器！” “但他们需要休息一下。今年夏天结束后，球员们没有参加大型比赛，当然切尔西的可用性比过去几年要好得多。

news.title: Xabi Alonso on ‘important’ Wesley Fofana and his centre-back options
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈“重要”韦斯利·福法纳和他的中后卫选择
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix has featured in every Chelsea game since joining from Crystal Palace this summer, but that run will end when we take on Manchester United. The defender’s absence leaves Xabi Alonso with a decision to make. Lacroix limped off at Anfield on Wednesday night, with Alonso confirming after the game that the France international had sustained a hamstring injury. At his pre-match media conference this afternoon, Alonso added that we are unlikely to see Lacroix in a Chelsea shirt again until after next month’s international break. Having started all but one Premier League fixture this term and our three Carabao Cup ties in the heart of defence, Lacroix’s unavailability leaves a hole that needs filling. Wesley Fofana is one defender Alonso can turn to, with Lacroix’s compatriot having played the full 90 minutes at Anfield. Although his penalty miss ultimately proved pivotal in the shootout, Alonso says Fofana performed well and is one of several defensive options that could be used against United. ‘With Max's injury, we have Wes, we have Levi [Colwill], Josh [Acheampong] could play as well as a centre-back, Jorrel [Hato] when he’s back with the team [after injury],’ explained Alonso. ‘For sure Wes has played, and even if he missed the penalty, I think that he had a good game. He was consistent, he was strong, and I saw many positives from his performance. ‘We know the level that he has had, and he's going to be important.’ Don't miss out! General admission tickets are sold out, so the only way to watch Chelsea vs Man Utd at Stamford Bridge is with a Chelsea hospitality package. A limited number of packages remain. Book hospitality now.
news.body_zh: 自从今年夏天从水晶宫加盟以来，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦在切尔西的每场比赛中都有出场，但当我们对阵曼联时，这种表现就会结束。后卫的缺席让哈维·阿隆索需要做出决定。周三晚上，拉克鲁瓦在安菲尔德一瘸一拐地下场，阿隆索赛后证实这位法国国脚腿筋受伤。在今天下午的赛前媒体发布会上，阿隆索补充说，在下个月的国际比赛日结束之前，我们不太可能再次看到拉克鲁瓦身披切尔西球衣。本赛季除了一场英超比赛之外，我们在后防线上的三场卡拉宝杯比赛中都首发出场，拉克鲁瓦的缺席留下了一个需要填补的漏洞。韦斯利·福法纳是阿隆索可以求助的后卫之一，拉克鲁瓦的同胞已经在安菲尔德打满了 90 分钟。尽管他的点球失误最终在点球大战中发挥了关键作用，但阿隆索表示福法纳表现出色，是可以用来对抗曼联的几个防守选择之一。阿隆索解释道，“由于马克斯受伤，我们有韦斯、列维（科尔威尔）、约什（阿切姆蓬），当他（受伤后）回归球队时，乔什（阿切姆蓬）可以打得和中后卫一样好。” “毫无疑问，韦斯参加了比赛，即使他罚丢了点球，我认为他打出了一场精彩的比赛。他很稳定，很坚强，我从他的表现中看到了很多积极的一面。 “我们知道他的水平，他将会变得很重要。”不要错过！普通门票已售完，因此观看切尔西在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的唯一方式就是购买切尔西招待套餐。剩余数量有限。立即预订招待。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Manchester United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为曼联效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso does not expect Maxence Lacroix to return to action before the international break due to a hamstring issue, but Moises Caicedo is available for selection against Manchester United. After midweek heartache in the Carabao Cup, which saw us exit the competition after a penalty shootout defeat to Liverpool, the Blues’ focus has switched back to the Premier League. Our opening eight top-flight fixtures have yielded 13 points and put us fifth in the early-season table. United, in contrast, sit 16th having won just once thus far in the league. Alonso will be forced into changes against the Red Devils, one of which will be deciding who replaces Lacroix after the centre-back came off during Wednesday’s game at Anfield. ‘Max picked up an injury and we expect that he will not be ready before the international break,’ the Blues manager explained in his pre-match press conference. ‘So he will be a few weeks out.’ Alonso also confirmed that Jorrel Hato will be absent against United. ‘How long, we don't know, but he’s not available for tomorrow. He has a back problem and he's not feeling okay for tomorrow.’ Pep Chavarria is in contention after missing our last three matches, and Caicedo is also available despite coming off in the second half against Liverpool. ‘No issue', replied Alonso when asked about the Ecuadorian. ‘He is ok for tomorrow.’ There was also an update provided on Argentine duo Aaron Anselmino, who has yet to feature this season, and Emi Martinez. On Anselmino, Alonso said: ‘He is not available yet. He has had a few things, a few injuries, and it will take a few weeks until he is fully fit. We need to be cautious with him as he's had a few of them, so he is still not there.' Martinez has been sidelined since our victory at Everton, after which he required jaw surgery following a clash with Jarrad Branthwaite. But Alonso believes it is possible the 34-year-old will be available before the international break. ‘Yes, there is a chance,' he said. 'We need to still wait for next week, but let’s see how things go. But there is a chance.’ Don't miss out! General admission tickets are sold out, so the only way to watch Chelsea vs Man Utd at Stamford Bridge is with a Chelsea hospitality package. A limited number of packages remain. Book hospitality now.
news.body_zh: 由于腿筋问题，哈维·阿隆索预计马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦不会在国际比赛日之前重返赛场，但莫伊塞斯·凯塞多可以入选对阵曼联的比赛。周中卡拉宝杯的比赛令人心痛，我们在点球大战中输给利物浦后退出了比赛，蓝军的注意力又回到了英超联赛。我们的前八场顶级联赛比赛拿到了 13 分，在赛季初期排名第五。相比之下，曼联目前在联赛中只赢过一次，排名第 16 位。阿隆索将被迫在对阵红魔的比赛中做出改变，其中之一将是在周三安菲尔德的比赛中拉克鲁瓦下场后决定由谁来接替拉克鲁瓦。 “马克斯受伤了，我们预计他在国际比赛日之前不会做好准备，”蓝军主教练在赛前新闻发布会上解释道。 “所以他将缺席几周。”阿隆索还证实乔雷尔·哈托将缺席对阵曼联的比赛。 “我们不知道要多久，但他明天不能上场。他的背部有问题，明天感觉不太好。” 佩普·查瓦里亚在缺席了我们过去三场比赛后仍处于争夺之中，而凯塞多也能上场，尽管他在对阵利物浦的下半场比赛中下场。当被问及厄瓜多尔人时，阿隆索回答说：“没问题。” “他明天表现不错。”还有关于本赛季尚未出场的阿根廷二人组亚伦·安塞尔米诺和埃米·马丁内斯的最新消息。关于安塞尔米诺，阿隆索说：“他还不能上场。”他经历了一些事情，受了一些伤，需要几周的时间才能完全康复。我们需要对他保持谨慎，因为他已经有过一些这样的经历了，所以他仍然不在那里。”自从我们战胜埃弗顿以来，马丁内斯就一直缺席比赛，之后他在与贾拉德·布兰斯维特发生冲突后需要接受下颌手术。但阿隆索相信这位 34 岁的球员有可能在国际比赛日之前上场。 “是的，有机会，”他说。 “我们还需要等待下周，但让我们看看事情进展如何。但有机会。”不要错过！普通门票已售完，因此观看切尔西在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的唯一方式就是购买切尔西招待套餐。剩余数量有限。立即预订招待。

news.title: Kobe Barbour signs new deal

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen’s Kobe Barbour has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2030. Since joining the Blues as an Under-8, Barbour has steadily progressed through the youth ranks. He was also part of the sides which won the Under-16 Premier League and Under-17 Premier League Cup in 2024. The attacking midfielder, who can play both centrally and out wide, scored five goals and provided two assists in 2025/26 for the Under-18s. He made five league appearances for CNG in the same campaign and marked his UEFA Youth League debut with a goal in our 5-2 victory over Benfica.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布科巴姆下一代球员科比·巴伯 (Kobe Barbour) 签署了一份新合同，他将在俱乐部效力至少到 2030 年 6 月。自从作为 8 岁以下球员加入蓝军以来，巴伯在青年队中稳步进步。他还是2024年赢得U-16英超联赛和U-17英超联赛杯冠军的球队成员之一。这位攻击型中场可以踢中路和边路，在2025/26赛季为U-18队打进5球并贡献2次助攻。同一赛季，他为 CNG 联赛出场五次，并在我们 5-2 战胜本菲卡的比赛中打进一球，这是他在青年联赛中的处子秀。

news.title: Levi Colwill: We’re learning with every day and every game
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔：我们每天、每场比赛都在学习
news.body_en: Levi Colwill believes he and his fellow Chelsea players are developing and improving as a team every time they step out onto the pitch, and he is excited by the chance to show it in our upcoming matches. Results have been mixed since the last international break, with back-to-back Premier League victories over Bournemouth and Everton followed by a loss to Tottenham Hotspur and Wednesday’s narrow Carabao Cup exit on penalties at Liverpool. However, Colwill underlined that this Blues side is still learning under manager Xabi Alonso and taking every opportunity to gel and improve. ‘Every day we're learning and we're coming closer together as a team,’ said the defender. ‘I think we take something from each performance, win or lose. ‘We're really starting to become a unit and believe and want to fight for each other. I think this season, when we go into really good form, we can try and push up the league as much as we can, and hopefully win a competition in there too. But we've got some really big games coming up and we're excited for them.’ The next of those games arrives in Saturday’s early kick-off, when Chelsea host Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. Ahead of that fixture, Colwill pointed out that the learning process is not just for the team, explaining how as a player at the highest level you never stop developing as an individual either. ‘I feel like you always learn things when you play; every season I learn something new,’ he said, before sharing the most important lesson he has gleaned as a footballer. ‘Probably for me, compared to when I first started, making my debut, it'd probably just be to try and meet the team and be a big character. When I was younger, it's a lot harder and I know I was much quieter than I am now. ‘I like to try and talk as much as possible, give them as much confidence as possible. So probably just be a leader and speak that bit further.’ Another source of confidence is Alonso’s presence in the dugout. The footballing ability our manager still shows on the training pitch demands the respect of his players, while Colwill was impressed by our manager right from their first conversation in the summer. ‘His technique that he shows every day on the football pitch is insane. He could still be playing out there somewhere,’ added Levi. ‘So when you're doing sessions with him and he can make a pass that the majority of players out there can't do, it really humbles you a bit. ‘My first conversation with him was in pre-season. It was just a get-to-know-him conversation, to know a little about him. ‘Of course, he would've heard a little bit about me from the other coaches and players maybe. But it was a really chill conversation. It gave me a lot of confidence and I was really excited to get to work with him, and I have been really happy working with him.’
news.body_zh: 列维·科尔威尔相信，他和他的切尔西队友每次踏上球场时，都在作为一个团队不断发展和进步，他很高兴有机会在我们即将举行的比赛中展示这一点。自上次国际比赛日以来，结果好坏参半，英超联赛连续战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿，随后输给托特纳姆热刺，周三在卡拉宝杯点球大战中险些出局。然而，科尔威尔强调，这支蓝军仍在主教练哈维·阿隆索的带领下学习，并抓住一切机会凝聚和提高。 “我们每天都在学习，作为一个团队，我们的距离越来越近，”这名后卫说道。 “我认为我们从每场比赛中都能学到一些东西，无论输赢。 “我们真的开始成为一个整体，相信并希望为彼此而战。我认为这个赛季，当我们进入真正良好的状态时，我们可以尝试尽可能地提升联赛排名，并希望也能赢得那里的比赛。但我们即将迎来一些非常重要的比赛，我们为它们感到兴奋。”下一场比赛将于周六提前开赛，届时切尔西将在英超联赛的斯坦福桥迎战曼联。在那场比赛之前，科尔威尔指出，学习过程不仅仅是为了球队，他解释了作为一名最高水平的球员，你也永远不会停止个人的发展。 “我觉得你在玩耍时总是能学到东西；每个赛季我都会学到一些新东西，”他在分享他作为一名足球运动员学到的最重要的教训之前说道。 “对我来说，与我刚开始首次亮相时相比，可能只是尝试与团队见面并成为一个大人物。当我年轻的时候，这要困难得多，我知道我比现在安静得多。 “我喜欢尝试尽可能多地交谈，给他们尽可能多的信心。因此，可能只是成为一名领导者并进一步发言。”另一个信心来源是阿隆索在教练席上的表现。我们的主教练在训练场上仍然展现出的足球能力需要他的球员们的尊重，而科尔威尔从夏天的第一次谈话就对我们的主教练印象深刻。 “他每天在足球场上展示的技术是疯狂的。他可能还在某个地方打球，”利维补充道。 “所以当你和他一起训练时，他能传出大多数球员都做不到的传球，这真的会让你感到有点谦卑。 “我和他的第一次谈话是在季前赛期间。这只是一次了解他的谈话，了解一些关于他的事情。 “当然，他也许会从其他教练和球员那里听说过一些关于我的事情。但这是一次非常冷静的谈话。这给了我很大的信心，我很高兴能和他一起工作，而且我很高兴与他一起工作。”

news.title: All you need to know: Chelsea vs Manchester United
news.title_zh: 您需要知道的一切：切尔西 vs 曼联
news.body_en: A classic Premier League fixture gets the weekend schedule under way, as Stamford Bridge hosts Chelsea against Manchester United. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton set the scene… The 12.30pm kick-off on Saturday is the latest instalment of a 121-year-old north/south rivalry. Halloween does not strictly start until sundown, but it’s a trick or treat lunch-time for two sides looking to make up for home losses last weekend. While the clocks went back an hour last weekend it was more like eight years at the Bridge – the most recent time Spurs had triumphed at our west London citadel. Fright night came early for the Blues as the Lilywhites won for only the second time in 42 visits to the Bridge and we slipped to fifth as a result. United’s bone-chiller was a 3-0 loss to Bournemouth at Old Trafford, days after a 4-1 Champions League calamity at Como.  That leaves Michael Carrick’s side 16th in the Premier League, one point clear of the relegation zone and without a win in eight games across all competitions. The Mancunians have gathered half-a-dozen league points fewer than at the same stage last season and are winless in six on all fronts on the road. Chelsea’s most recent appearance in this early Saturday time-slot ended with a 2-0 victory at Everton – meaning we are now unbeaten in the past 11 such fixtures, winning nine. While the world champions bowed out of the Carabao Cup on penalties at Liverpool on Wednesday, United had a free week, though they face a crucial European tie at home to Roma on Tuesday. The corresponding fixture last season ended 1-0 to United – the Blues’ first home loss to the Red Devils in six years. Chelsea have played United previously at the Bridge on Halloween in 2012 – the reigning European champions winning a nine-goal thriller in round four of the League Cup. Cole Palmer is back from suspension to face opponents he loves to score against, and a win in the weekend-opener would lift Xabi Alonso’s side back into the top four. Chelsea’s first Saturday 12.30pm kick-off, in January 2003, ended in a 2-1 loss at the home of this weekend’s visitors. Eidur Gudjohnsen opened the scoring for Claudio Ranieri’s team but Diego Forlan notched a last-minute winner. Our first win in this time slot in September the same year was an emphatic one – a 5-0 walloping of Wolverhampton Wanderers at Molineux. Frank Lampard broke the deadlock and brilliant Argentina striker Hernan Crespo stole the show off the bench with a brace. A 2-0 lunchtime win at Bolton in March 2004 (thanks to John Terry and Damien Duff) presaged the same scoreline there a year later when the Blues clinched the Premier League title. The early kick-off against Charlton at the Bridge in May 2005 saw the champions win 1-0 after cult hero Claude Makelele was cajoled into taking a penalty, missed, but scored the rebound. A year later we completed back-to-back title wins with a lunchtime leathering of rival challengers Man United. On a glorious afternoon at the Bridge, William Gallas lashed home to open the scoring, then Joe Cole dazzled defenders and fired past Edwin van der Sar, before Ricardo Carvalho capped a rare strike with a cigar-puffing celebration. The weekend-opener on 3 December 2016 at the Etihad was another title statement – a 3-1 win that secured top spot for Antonio Conte’s side. Diego Costa, Willian and Eden Hazard found the net for the Londoners and City were shown two late red cards. When Arsenal fell victim to the Blues in February 2017 the standout goal was Hazard’s extraordinary slalom run round most of their team. Marcos Alonso started the scoring and Cesc Fabregas finished it for a 3-1 result in the hosts’ favour. Until the midday massacre of Norwich in October 2021 (featuring a Mason Mount hat-trick) the well-worked 4-0 beating of Brighton on their own patch in January 2018 was our biggest margin of victory in that TV slot. Once against it was Belgian maestro Hazard whose two goals inspired the Blues on the south coast. The current run of no loss in 11 at this time on a Saturday began with a 3-2 win at Luton just after Christmas 2023, Palmer on target twice either side of Noni Madueke’s goal. In that unbeaten sequence the Blues have beaten West Ham 3-2, Leicester 2-1, Forest 3-0, Burnley 2-0, Fulham twice (1-0 and 2-0) and likewise Everton - 1-0 and earlier this month 2-0 at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. - The Blues have committed the fewest fouls in the Premier League (79) apart from Everton (65). - Man United have covered less ground than each Premier League opponent they have faced this season. - The visitors have failed to keep a clean sheet in each of their last eight league fixtures. - Michael Carrick’s team have conceded an equaliser on four of the five occasions they have taken the lead in the top flight. - The Blues’ tally of seven shots attempted against Tottenham was our lowest in the Premier League since our May 2026 loss to Man City (also seven). - Since Sir Alex Ferguson left Old Trafford in 2013, Man Utd have gained the fifth-most Premier League points (869), behind Chelsea in fourth (902). - As this is the closest home match to 11 November, the club will mark Remembrance Day before kick-off. - On 31 October 1913 Olympic medal-winning midfielder Nils Middelboe was transferred from BK Copenhagen to Stamford Bridge, where he captained the Blues and became English football’s first overseas star – ‘the Great Dane’.
news.body_zh: 一场经典的英超联赛将在周末赛程开始，斯坦福桥将主场迎战切尔西对阵曼联。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔 (Rick Glanvill) 和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿 (Paul Dutton) 设定了场景……周六中午 12 点 30 分的开球是长达 121 年的南北对抗的最新一期。万圣节严格来说要到日落才开始，但对于两支希望弥补上周末主场失利的球队来说，这是一个不给糖就捣蛋的午餐时间。虽然上周末时钟倒退了一个小时，但这更像是在桥上的八年——这是热刺最近一次在我们伦敦西部的城堡取得胜利。对于蓝军来说，可怕的夜晚来得很早，因为白百合队在 42 次造访大桥的比赛中仅第二次获胜，结果我们滑落至第五位。曼联的一场令人不寒而栗的比赛是在老特拉福德以 3-0 输给伯恩茅斯，几天前，他们在科莫以 4-1 输掉了欧冠联赛的灾难。这使得迈克尔·卡里克的球队在英超联赛中排名第16位，比降级区高出一分，并且在所有比赛中的八场比赛中没有取得胜利。曼彻斯特人队的联赛积分比上赛季同期少了六分，并且在客场​​的所有战线上六场比赛都没有获胜。切尔西在周六早些时候的最近一场比赛以 2-0 战胜埃弗顿结束——这意味着我们在过去 11 场此类比赛中保持不败，赢了 9 场。尽管世界冠军队周三在利物浦的点球大战中退出了卡拉宝杯，但曼联却享受了一周的空闲时间，尽管他们周二将在主场迎战罗马的关键欧洲比赛。上赛季的相应比赛以曼联 1-0 告终，这是蓝军六年来首次在主场输给红魔。切尔西此前曾于 2012 年万圣节在桥球场对阵曼联，这支欧洲卫冕冠军在联赛杯第四轮中以 9 粒进球惊险获胜。科尔·帕尔默从停赛中恢复，将面对他喜欢得分的对手，周末揭幕战的一场胜利将使哈维·阿隆索的球队重返前四。 2003 年 1 月，切尔西首次在周六中午 12 点 30 分开球，最终以 2-1 输给了本周末客队。埃杜尔·古德约翰森为克劳迪奥·拉涅利的球队首开纪录，但迭戈·弗兰在最后一刻攻入制胜球。同年 9 月，我们在这个时间段内取得的首场胜利非常震撼——在莫利纽克斯 5-0 横扫狼队。弗兰克·兰帕德打破了僵局，出色的阿根廷前锋埃尔南·克雷斯波替补出场，梅开二度抢尽风头。 2004 年 3 月午餐时 2-0 战胜博尔顿（感谢约翰·特里和达米恩·达夫）预示着一年后蓝军夺得英超冠军时同样的比分。 2005 年 5 月，在蓝桥对阵查尔顿的比赛中，冠军队以 1-0 获胜，崇拜英雄克洛德·马克莱莱 (Claude Makelele) 在哄骗下主罚点球，错失点球，但抢到篮板。一年后，我们在午餐时间击败了对手挑战者曼联，完成了背靠背的冠军头衔。在蓝桥度过的一个美好的下午，威廉·加拉斯率先破门，然后乔·科尔让防守队员眼花缭乱，并射门越过埃德温·范德萨，最后里卡多·卡瓦略抽着雪茄庆祝，完成了罕见的进球。 2016 年 12 月 3 日在阿提哈德球场举行的周末揭幕战是另一场冠军声明——安东尼奥·孔蒂的球队以 3-1 获胜，确保了榜首位置。迭戈·科斯塔、威廉和伊登·阿扎尔为伦敦人进球，曼城在比赛最后时刻被出示两张红牌。 2017 年 2 月，当阿森纳输给蓝军时，最引人注目的进球是阿扎尔在全队大部分球员身上出色的绕回绕行。马科斯·阿隆索率先得分，塞斯克·法布雷加斯进球，主队以 3-1 获胜。直到 2021 年 10 月中午屠杀诺维奇（梅森·芒特上演帽子戏法）之前，2018 年 1 月在布莱顿的主场 4-0 击败布莱顿是我们在该电视节目中最大的胜利。一次对阵比利时大师阿扎尔，他的两个进球激励了南海岸的蓝军。目前周六的11场比赛不败的记录始于2023年圣诞节后不久，球队以3-2战胜卢顿，帕尔默在诺尼·马杜克的球门两侧各入两球。在不败的系列赛中，蓝军以3-2击败西汉姆联，以2-1击败莱斯特城，以3-0击败森林队，以2-0击败伯恩利，两次击败富勒姆（1-0和2-0），同样以1-0击败埃弗顿，以及本月早些时候在希尔迪金森体育场以2-0击败埃弗顿。 - 除了埃弗顿（65）之外，蓝军是英超联赛中犯规次数最少的球队（79）。 - 曼联的占地面积比他们本赛季面对的每个英超对手都要少。 - 客队在过去八场联赛中均未能保持不失球。 - 迈克尔·卡里克的球队在顶级联赛中五次领先，其中有四次丢球扳平比分。 - 蓝军对阵托特纳姆热刺队的七次射门总数是自 2026 年 5 月输给曼城（同样是七次）以来英超联赛中最低的。 - 自 2013 年弗格森爵士离开老特拉福德以来，曼联已获得英超联赛积分第五（869），仅次于排名第四的切尔西（902）。 - 由于这是距 11 月 11 日最近的主场比赛，俱乐部将在开赛前纪念阵亡将士纪念日。 - 1913 年 10 月 31 日，奥运会奖牌获得者尼尔斯·米德尔博 (Nils Middelboe) 从哥本哈根 BK 转会到斯坦福桥，在那里他担任蓝军队长，并成为英格兰足球第一位海外明星——“大丹犬”。

news.body_en: Today we announce ART OF as an official merchandising partner of Chelsea Football Club and to mark this moment, the first four clothing pieces designed by ART OF are available to buy now. ART OF is a fan-led brand that taps into the moments that define the fan experience and the culture of fan communities. Freshly on sale in our online store and the Megastore at Stamford Bridge are two designs of t-shirt and two hoodie designs, each with a distinctive Chelsea feature on the front. For the Chelsea Pickles T-Shirt, which is available in white, it is ART OF’s mascot Pickles the Bear wearing an all-time classic home shirt from the mid-1980s, ensuring you can carry the pride of Chelsea's legacy wherever you are. The colour changes to navy blue for the Chelsea Classics T-Shirt with two iconic home jerseys and two famous away strips in a high-quality print, perfect for marking yourself out as a true fan wherever you are. It is a celebration of our past kits that is repeated on the navy Chelsea Classics Hoodie on which the embroidered design depicts those four shirts from the team's history, drawing on decades of Chelsea heritage to create a truly standout design. Completing the range unveiled today, the Chelsea Stadium Hoodie celebrates Stamford Bridge with an intricately embroidered depiction of our home ground. Given fans are behind these ideas, keeping them under wraps has not been the easiest. ‘I've been Proper Chels since before I knew what that meant,’ says Kelvyn, the Head of Brand for ART OF. ‘Growing up in south London, football was never just something you watched. It was who you were. ‘This collection is the first time the worlds of ART OF and Chelsea FC have properly met. Not a partnership dreamed up in a boardroom. One built from actually growing up in the stands, expressing what it means to be a Blue, and now getting to make something with the club I've supported my whole life. ‘Every piece here carries that with it. Official Chelsea FC merchandise, delivered by someone who's lived every moment of life at Chelsea in Matthew Harding Lower.’ Click to shop the Chelsea FC Collection by ART OF or visit the Stamford Bridge Megastore

news.title: Chelsea vs Manchester United: Key statistics and facts
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 曼联：关键统计数据和事实
news.body_en: Chelsea hit a double century of games against Manchester United when they visit Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. Here are all the key facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea head into the second of consecutive home league fixtures in fifth in the table, two points behind fourth-placed Liverpool. Saturday’s opponents Manchester United have seven points from their eight games played so far and are in 16th. The Blues face Manchester United for the 200th time in all competitions, the third opponent we have reached this milestone against after Arsenal (216 meetings) and Liverpool (201). John Terry (34), Frank Lampard (31) and Peter Bonetti (28) have made the most appearances against the Red Devils, while Bobby Tambling (seven), Tommy Baldwin (six) and Frank Lampard (six) have scored the most goals. Manchester United were among the 19 teams Chelsea faced in our debut season in 1905/06 in Division Two. Hull City are the only other current Premier League side who were also in the division that season. Our most recent Premier League wins against Man United were at home in May 2025 and April 2024. Chelsea playing Manchester United is the most drawn fixture in Premier League history, with 27 of the previous 68 meetings between the sides finishing level. news.title: Remembrance at Chelsea – Saturday’s support for poppy appeal, wartime heritage event and pre-match commemoration
news.title_zh: 切尔西的纪念活动——周六支持罂粟呼吁、战时遗产活动和赛前纪念活动
news.body_en: With this weekend’s Premier League match at Stamford Bridge being our closest men's home game to Remembrance Sunday and the last before Armistice Day, Chelsea Football Club will be honouring those lost in conflict and supporting the Royal British Legion’s annual Poppy Appeal at the fixture. In addition, there will be Remembrance Day commemorations as part of a special heritage event organised by supporters at the stadium prior to the game. Poppies will be available from sellers located around the stadium who will accept both contactless and cash payment. The Royal British Legion uses funds raised to support serving members of the Armed Forces, veterans and their families. Ahead of kick-off for our meeting with Manchester United, the teams will be led out of the tunnel by Chelsea Pensioners from the Royal Hospital Chelsea. The UK Armed Forces Chelsea Official Supporters Club will play their part by holding both the poppy centre-circle banner and a new Remembrance-themed banner which will be unveiled on the pitch. Remembrance will be marked in the stands as well with a dedicated crowd-surfing banner in the Matthew Harding Stand and, at the other end of the stadium, a display organised by We Are The Shed. There will be a silence honouring those who lost their lives in conflict across the world, with The Last Post played by a trumpeter of the Central Band of the Royal Air Force. In Saturday's matchday programme, Xabi Alonso and Reece James will write about Remembrance in their respective manager's and captain's notes. Chelsea FC Women will be marking Remembrance at their dedicated match on Saturday 7 November, when the team play Everton Women at Stamford Bridge. With support from Official Online Match Shirt Auction Partner,MatchWornShirt, the jerseys with embroidered poppies, worn and signed by the relevant player, will be auctioned. All net proceeds are donated to the Royal British Legion appeal. The latest in the exciting series of Those Were The Days events, held in collaboration with the Chelsea Heritage Partnership, takes place from 10.30am on Saturday in the Tea Bar. It features Remembrance Day commemorations, with members of our Armed Forces joining, subject to matchday timings.The event focuses on an incident dating back over 100 years to the First World War, when Chelsea were thevictims of a match-fixing scandal between two of our great rivals, Liverpool and Manchester United.It will also feature: An on-screen presentation from club historian, Rick Glanvill, reflecting on those players andstaff who made the ultimate sacrifice in the war Prized historical artefacts and photos on display around the venue On-screen coverage of iconic past matches against the Red Devils and memorabilia from these great games The Tea Bar is at the South End of the stadium, between Frankie’s and the ticket office and opposite the Shed Wall. Poppies will be available to purchase there. Chelsea Foundation has made a donation to the Royal Hospital Chelsea, made possible through a percentage of profits from the Chelsea Pensioners-inspired Heritage Collection that was available last year.Click on these links for Chelsea wartime history and rolls of honour: Chelsea in the Second World War
news.body_zh: 本周末在斯坦福桥举行的英超联赛是我们距离纪念周日最近的一场男子主场比赛，也是停战日之前的最后一场比赛，切尔西足球俱乐部将向在冲突中丧生的人们致敬，并在比赛中支持英国皇家军团的年度罂粟呼吁。此外，作为比赛前球迷在体育场组织的特别遗产活​​动的一部分，还将举行阵亡将士纪念日纪念活动。罂粟花可以从体育场周围的卖家那里购买，他们接受非接触式支付和现金支付。英国皇家军团利用筹集的资金来支持现役武装部队成员、退伍军人及其家人。在我们与曼联的比赛开始之前，球队将在切尔西皇家医院的切尔西养老金领取者的带领下走出隧道。英国武装部队切尔西官方支持者俱乐部将发挥自己的作用，举着罂粟花中心圈横幅和新的纪念主题横幅，该横幅将在球场上揭晓。看台上以及马修·哈丁看台上都会悬挂专门的人群冲浪横幅，在体育场的另一端，我们将组织一场由 We Are The Shed 组织的展示，以纪念这一事件。皇家空军中央乐队的小号手将演奏《最后的邮报》，为世界各地在冲突中丧生的人们默哀。在周六的比赛日节目中，哈维·阿隆索和里斯·詹姆斯将在各自的主教练和队长笔记中写下有关纪念的内容。切尔西女足将于 11 月 7 日星期六在斯坦福桥迎战埃弗顿女足，在这场专门的比赛中纪念这一活动。在官方在线比赛球衣拍卖合作伙伴MatchWornShirt的支持下，由相关球员穿着并签名的绣有罂粟花的球衣将被拍卖。所有净收益均捐赠给英国皇家军团呼吁。与切尔西传统合作伙伴合作举办的“那些日子”系列激动人心的活动中的最新活动将于周六上午 10 点 30 分在 Tea Bar 举行。它以阵亡将士纪念日为特色，根据比赛日的时间安排，我们的武装部队成员将参加。该活动重点关注可追溯到第一次世界大战 100 多年前的事件，当时切尔西是我们两个伟大对手利物浦和曼联之间假球丑闻的受害者。它还将包括： 俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔的屏幕演示，反思那些在战争中做出最终牺牲的球员和工作人员场馆周围展示的文物和照片 屏幕上覆盖了过去对阵红魔的标志性比赛以及这些伟大比赛的纪念品 茶吧位于体育场南端，在弗兰基和售票处之间，在棚墙对面。那里可以买到罂粟花。切尔西基金会已向切尔西皇家医院捐款，这笔捐款是通过从去年推出的切尔西养老金领取者启发的遗产系列中获得的一定比例的利润来实现的。点击这些链接了解切尔西战时历史和荣誉榜：第二次世界大战中的切尔西

news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues players are the best value-for-money picks, why Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week and who to captain in Gameweek 9. The deadline is at 11am GMT on Saturday ahead of the Blues’ clash with Manchester United. Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is the most popular Chelsea player ahead of Gameweek 9 with over 130,000 transfers in. The Englishman’s ownership has reached 50%, making him the most-selected midfielder in Fantasy, and has risen in price to £8.0m after starting the season at £7.5m. In the last six Gameweeks, Rogers ranks second for shots (14), second for expected goals (1.03) and fourth for chances created (5) among Blues players. The summer signing scored against Liverpool in the EFL Cup on Wednesday, smartly converting his first-half penalty. Also proving popular is Pedro Neto (£6.6m), who returned defensive contribution points against Spurs last time out, backing up his 15-point haul against Everton in Gameweek 7. The Portugal international scored twice and notched maximum bonus points. In the last six Gameweeks, Neto sits in the top three for shots on goal and chances created among Blues players, while no Chelsea player has registered more expected goal involvement in that time. Over 80,000 managers have purchased the right-winger. Despite getting a red card against Spurs, Cole Palmer (£9.8m) is not suspended for GW9. The Englishman has a brilliant record against Man United in a Chelsea shirt, scoring four goals in six starts, including a hat-trick back in the 2023/24 season. Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) has started each of the last three Gameweeks and played the full game at Anfield in midweek. The England under-21 international’s expected minutes have only increased with Maxence Lacroix (£5.9m) picking up a hamstring injury. Acheampong has produced defensive contribution points twice this season in five starts and averages over 7.5 DefCon per/90. At just £4.5m, Acheampong has the potential to provide very good value in your FPL defence. In goal, Mike Penders (£4.4m) is the cheapest starting goalkeeper in the game and made three saves against both Spurs and Liverpool. Opponents Man United have scored just three goals in the last five Gameweeks ahead of Saturday’s fixture. Erling Haaland (£15.8m) is once again a reliable captaincy option for Man City’s home fixture against Brighton. The Norwegian has scored in seven consecutive Gameweeks with nine goals, two double-digit hauls, 14 bonus points and 64 Fantasy points in that time. No player has had more shots on target or xGI than the league’s top-scorer, while the Seagulls conceded three goals last time out away at Liverpool. Elsewhere, Nicolas Jackson (£6.8m) is an intriguing, differential option against Fulham. The West London side have conceded 22 big chances in eight matches.
